name: Nezahualcoyotl
shortBio: Texcoco ruler, architect, and philosopher of the Nahua tlamatinime tradition; investigated the transience of earthly life, the search for rooted truth (neltiliztli), and divine communication through 'flower and song'.
centralQuestion: Can anything be rooted and truly steadfast on this fleeting, slippery earth, or do humans only dream while awake?

keyWorks.title: Cantares Mexicanos (Nahuatl Philosophical Cantos)
keyWorks.description: Lyric poetry corpus exploring the ontological instability of existence, friendship, and communion with the Giver of Life through flower and song.

keyWorks.title: Romances de los Señores de la Nueva España
keyWorks.description: Collection of Nahua intellectual discourses, meditation on mortality, and statecraft laws.
